ja: 「ねこ」フィギュアに「ジャケット」を着せ「ぶそう」パーツを装備させて楽しむ新感覚Hobby！
• 第１弾に続き、原型はねこ造形作家として活躍中の森口修氏が担当。表情や毛並み、肉球など、細部に至るまで造形。
• 第２弾のメカデザインは倉持キョーリュー氏が担当。動物型からマシン型へのシルエット変化の妙を発揮。
• 「ぶそう」は単独でミニメカ状態にも組み替え可能。ジャケットや各ぶそうに搭載された3mmジョイントにより組み合わせは自由自在。
• 複数組み合わせることで、さらに大きなねこぶそうに組み替えることができる。第１弾との組み合わせも可能。ユーザーの数だけニャスタマイズがある！
• 〈並盛り〉はA,B,C,Dの４種。Aはエジプト座りねこ「シロサバ」とカラスメカのぶそうセット。Bはエジプト座りねこ「シャム」とカタツムリメカのぶそうセット。Cは香箱座りねこ「しろ」とネズミメカのぶそうセット。Dは香箱座りねこ「とびミケ」とトカゲメカのぶそうセット。
en: A new type of hobby where you can enjoy wearing a "jacket" on a "cat" figure and equipping it with "buso" parts!
• Continuing from the first edition, Osamu Moriguchi, who is active as a cat sculptor, is in charge of the prototype. Every detail is sculpted, including facial expressions, fur, and paws.
• Kyoryu Kuramochi is in charge of the second mechanical design. The silhouette changes from an animal shape to a machine shape.
• "Buso" can be rearranged into a mini-mecha state by itself. You can freely combine them with the 3mm joints installed on the jacket and each bush.
• By combining multiple pieces, you can make an even bigger catfish. Can also be combined with the first edition. There are as many customizations as there are users!

• There are 4 types of ``Norimori'': A, B, C, and D. A is a set of the Egyptian sitting cat "Shirosaba" and a crow mecha. B is an Egyptian sitting cat "Siamese" and a snail mecha play set. C is a set of Kobako sitting cat "Shiro" and a mouse mechanism. D is a set of Kobako sitting cat "Tobimike" and lizard mecha Nobuso.
